terms.definition: Suppression or reduced outgrowth of lateral buds associated with the activity of a dominant shoot apex and interacting hormonal and resource signals.
A bud located in the angle between a leaf and stem that can develop into a lateral shoot.
The orientation of a branch relative to its supporting stem or a defined reference plane.
The spatial distribution of plant tissue across the available horizontal and vertical growing area.
The amount and distribution of open space within foliage and branches through which light and air can move.
Intentional removal of leaves from a plant canopy.
Removal of actively dividing shoot tissue that would otherwise continue primary growth.
The period and observable plant response between a structural intervention and resumed stable growth.
A support structure used to hold, position, or distribute shoots and branches in space.
The dynamic relationship between tissues that export assimilates and tissues that consume or store them.
